name: Keyra Hamburg grand calibration split, 31 October 2026
written_before: any fitting, model selection or scoring of a calibration against these files; after an inventory that opened every file (length, level, onset, partials per take) and compared the takes' first 30 ms between 2 and 12 kHz

rules.train: every layer's first take at the 10 recorded pitches other than those below, with their release takes
rules.dev: every first take at E2 and C#4 (MIDI 52, 73), with their release takes: scored at every iteration and used to choose between candidates, never fitted. The library records only 12 pitches, so nothing is sealed: a third held-out pitch would leave a 21-semitone hole
rules.repeat: every second take: neither fitted nor scored. Same-layer pairs correlate at a median of 0.94 over the impact (39 of 48 at 0.8 or more), so they cannot be shown to hold out their first takes, though in the treble the partials alone correlate that highly; C#4 Dyn2 RR2 and Dyn3 RR1 are one strike

velocity_mapping: a layer plays at the rounded midpoint of its preset velocity range: 31, 80, 108, 123
